summary: @greenlake/session postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP collector
details: The package is a functionless shim whose main entry (index.js) exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access. Its only real behavior is a beacon: the declared postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, and index.js also invokes the beacon on require(), so the code fires both on install and on module load. beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), Node version, and the package name, and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The scoped name, stub implementation, and recon-only beacon are consistent with a dependency-confusion / namesquat reconnaissance package targeting internal builds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
